name: Istio Upgrade Readiness
summary: Assess an Istio source-to-target upgrade or downgrade using supplied inventory, installation configuration, release documentation and test evidence. Use for control/data-plane skew, canary revisions, Helm or istioctl transitions, CRD storage changes, extension compatibility, ambient components or rollback readiness. Produce a dependency plan and blockers; do not install, upgrade, restart, delete or assume the latest release.
security_notes: Static review only. Never assume latest-version support or execute an upgrade; require source-to-target, installation-method, skew, CRD, and rollback evidence.
